question: Melbourne poopoo has offered us Anthony Edwards (MIN) for Cade Cunningham (DET), one for one; the offer expires 30 Oct 2026 11:20 UTC. Edwards is out after arthroscopic right knee surgery (up to two months reported; ESPN est. return 21 Dec). Should we accept?

ballots.rationale: Cade beats Edwards per game even when both are healthy: 53.33 vs 46.24 FP_ACT_PG on 2026 actuals and 53.42 vs 47.98 on projection plus blind spot, so Edwards never overtakes him at any point in the season. Edwards is out until about 21 Dec (ESPN est.) or January, which costs us roughly 1,400-1,700 FP rest of season. It would also leave 2 of our 3 bench spots dead next to Kawhi while Duren holds the only IR, at 0-1 with matchup 2 projected 1,112 to 1,451 against us.
